+++ b/apps/web/convex/clients-and-galleries.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,393 @@
+import stripeSchema from "../node_modules/@convex-dev/stripe/dist/component/schema.js"
+import { convexTest } from "convex-test"
+import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest"
+
+import { api, components } from "./_generated/api"
+import type { Id } from "./_generated/dataModel"
+import schema from "./schema"
+
+const modules = {
+  "./_generated/api.js": () => import("./_generated/api.js"),
+  "./_generated/server.js": () => import("./_generated/server.js"),
+  "./clients.ts": () => import("./clients"),
+  "./galleries.ts": () => import("./galleries"),
+  "./users.ts": () => import("./users"),
+  "./workspaces.ts": () => import("./workspaces"),
+}
+
+const stripeModules = {
+  "./_generated/api.js": () =>
+    import("../node_modules/@convex-dev/stripe/dist/component/_generated/api.js"),
+  "./_generated/server.js": () =>
+    import("../node_modules/@convex-dev/stripe/dist/component/_generated/server.js"),
+  "./private.js": () =>
+    import("../node_modules/@convex-dev/stripe/dist/component/private.js"),
+  "./public.js": () =>
+    import("../node_modules/@convex-dev/stripe/dist/component/public.js"),
+}
+
+function setup() {
+  const t = convexTest(schema, modules)
+  t.registerComponent("stripe", stripeSchema, stripeModules)
+  return t
+}
+
+async function makePaid(
+  t: ReturnType<typeof setup>,
+  workspaceId: Id<"workspaces">
+) {
+  await t.mutation(components.stripe.private.handleSubscriptionCreated, {
+    stripeSubscriptionId: `sub_${workspaceId}`,
+    stripeCustomerId: `cus_${workspaceId}`,
+    status: "active",
+    currentPeriodEnd: Date.now() + 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000,
+    cancelAtPeriodEnd: false,
+    priceId: "price_test",
+    metadata: { orgId: workspaceId },
+  })
+}
+
+describe("clients and galleries", () => {
+  it("creates workspace clients and moves a gallery from draft to ready", async () => {
+    const t = setup()
+    const owner = t.withIdentity({ subject: "owner" })
+    const member = t.withIdentity({ subject: "member" })
+
+    await owner.mutation(api.users.ensureCurrent, {})
+    await member.mutation(api.users.ensureCurrent, {})
+    const workspaceId = await owner.mutation(api.workspaces.create, {
+      name: "Northlight Studio",
+    })
+    const otherWorkspaceId = await owner.mutation(api.workspaces.create, {
+      name: "Other studio",
+    })
+    await t.run(async (ctx) => {
+      const memberUser = await ctx.db
+        .query("users")
+        .withIndex("by_external_id", (query) =>
+          query.eq("externalId", "member")
+        )
+        .unique()
+
+      if (!memberUser) throw new Error("Test member was not created")
+
+      await ctx.db.insert("workspaceMembers", {
+        workspaceId,
+        userId: memberUser._id,
+        role: "member",
+      })
+    })
+    await makePaid(t, workspaceId)
+
+    const clientId = await member.mutation(api.clients.create, {
+      workspaceId,
+      name: "  Ada Lovelace  ",
+      email: "  ada@example.com  ",
+    })
+    const galleryId = await member.mutation(api.galleries.create, {
+      workspaceId,
+      clientId,
+      name: "  Wedding selects  ",
+    })
+
+    await expect(
+      owner.query(api.clients.list, { workspaceId })
+    ).resolves.toEqual([
+      expect.objectContaining({
+        _id: clientId,
+        name: "Ada Lovelace",
+        email: "ada@example.com",
+      }),
+    ])
+    await expect(
+      owner.query(api.galleries.list, { workspaceId })
+    ).resolves.toEqual([
+      expect.objectContaining({
+        _id: galleryId,
+        clientId,
+        clientName: "Ada Lovelace",
+        name: "Wedding selects",
+        status: "draft",
+        hasImages: false,
+      }),
+    ])
+
+    await expect(
+      member.mutation(api.galleries.markReady, { workspaceId, galleryId })
+    ).rejects.toThrow("Add at least one image before marking the gallery ready")
+
+    await t.run(async (ctx) => {
+      await ctx.db.insert("galleryImages", {
+        workspaceId: otherWorkspaceId,
+        galleryId,
+      })
+    })
+    await expect(
+      member.mutation(api.galleries.markReady, { workspaceId, galleryId })
+    ).rejects.toThrow("Add at least one image before marking the gallery ready")
+
+    await t.run(async (ctx) => {
+      await ctx.db.insert("galleryImages", { workspaceId, galleryId })
+    })
+
+    await expect(
+      owner.query(api.galleries.list, { workspaceId })
+    ).resolves.toEqual([
+      expect.objectContaining({
+        _id: galleryId,
+        hasImages: true,
+      }),
+    ])
+
+    await member.mutation(api.galleries.markReady, { workspaceId, galleryId })
+
+    await expect(
+      owner.query(api.galleries.list, { workspaceId })
+    ).resolves.toEqual([
+      expect.objectContaining({
+        _id: galleryId,
+        status: "ready",
+        readyAt: expect.any(Number),
+      }),
+    ])
+    await expect(
+      owner.mutation(api.galleries.markReady, { workspaceId, galleryId })
+    ).rejects.toThrow("Gallery is already ready")
+  })
+
+  it("requires a paid workspace for every state change", async () => {
+    const t = setup()
+    const owner = t.withIdentity({ subject: "owner" })
+
+    await owner.mutation(api.users.ensureCurrent, {})
+    const workspaceId = await owner.mutation(api.workspaces.create, {
+      name: "Northlight Studio",
+    })
+    const clientId = await t.run((ctx) =>
+      ctx.db.insert("clients", { workspaceId, name: "Ada Lovelace" })
+    )
+
+    await expect(
+      owner.mutation(api.clients.create, {
+        workspaceId,
+        name: "Ada Lovelace",
+      })
+    ).rejects.toThrow("A paid workspace subscription is required")
+    await expect(
+      owner.mutation(api.clients.update, {
+        workspaceId,
+        clientId,
+        name: "Ada Lovelace",
+      })
+    ).rejects.toThrow("A paid workspace subscription is required")
+    await expect(
+      owner.mutation(api.clients.remove, {
+        workspaceId,
+        clientId,
+      })
+    ).rejects.toThrow("A paid workspace subscription is required")
+  })
+

+import { v } from "convex/values"
+
+import { mutation, query } from "./_generated/server"
+import { requireWorkspaceMember } from "./lib/auth"
+import { requirePaidWorkspace } from "./lib/billing"
+
+export const list = query({
+  args: {
+    workspaceId: v.id("workspaces"),
+  },
+  handler: async (ctx, args) => {
+    await requireWorkspaceMember(ctx, args.workspaceId)
+
+    return await ctx.db
+      .query("clients")
+      .withIndex("by_workspace", (query) =>
+        query.eq("workspaceId", args.workspaceId)
+      )
+      .order("desc")
+      .take(100)
+  },
+})
+
+export const create = mutation({
+  args: {
+    workspaceId: v.id("workspaces"),
+    name: v.string(),
+    email: v.optional(v.string()),
+  },
+  handler: async (ctx, args) => {
+    await requirePaidWorkspace(ctx, args.workspaceId)
+
+    const name = args.name.trim()
+    const email = args.email?.trim() || undefined
+
+    if (!name) {
+      throw new Error("Client name is required")
+    }
+
+    return await ctx.db.insert("clients", {
+      workspaceId: args.workspaceId,
+      name,
+      email,
+    })
+  },
+})
+
+export const update = mutation({
+  args: {
+    workspaceId: v.id("workspaces"),
+    clientId: v.id("clients"),
+    name: v.string(),
+    email: v.optional(v.string()),
+  },
+  handler: async (ctx, args) => {
+    await requirePaidWorkspace(ctx, args.workspaceId)
+
+    const client = await ctx.db.get(args.clientId)
+
+    if (!client || client.workspaceId !== args.workspaceId) {
+      throw new Error("Client not found")
+    }
+
+    const name = args.name.trim()
+    const email = args.email?.trim() || undefined
+
+    if (!name) {
+      throw new Error("Client name is required")
+    }
+
+    await ctx.db.patch(args.clientId, { name, email })
+  },
+})
+
+export const remove = mutation({
+  args: {
+    workspaceId: v.id("workspaces"),
+    clientId: v.id("clients"),
+  },
+  handler: async (ctx, args) => {
+    await requirePaidWorkspace(ctx, args.workspaceId)
+
+    const client = await ctx.db.get(args.clientId)
+
+    if (!client || client.workspaceId !== args.workspaceId) {
+      throw new Error("Client not found")
+    }
+
+    const gallery = await ctx.db
+      .query("galleries")
+      .withIndex("by_workspace_and_client", (query) =>
+        query.eq("workspaceId", args.workspaceId).eq("clientId", args.clientId)
+      )
+      .first()
+
+    if (gallery) {
+      throw new Error(
+        "Delete this client's galleries before deleting the client"
+      )
+    }
+
+    await ctx.db.delete(args.clientId)
+  },
+})

+import { v } from "convex/values"
+
+import { mutation, query } from "./_generated/server"
+import { requireWorkspaceMember } from "./lib/auth"
+import { requirePaidWorkspace } from "./lib/billing"
+
+export const list = query({
+  args: {
+    workspaceId: v.id("workspaces"),
+  },
+  handler: async (ctx, args) => {
+    await requireWorkspaceMember(ctx, args.workspaceId)
+
+    const galleries = await ctx.db
+      .query("galleries")
+      .withIndex("by_workspace", (query) =>
+        query.eq("workspaceId", args.workspaceId)
+      )
+      .order("desc")
+      .take(100)
+
+    return await Promise.all(
+      galleries.map(async (gallery) => {
+        const [client, image] = await Promise.all([
+          ctx.db.get(gallery.clientId),
+          ctx.db
+            .query("galleryImages")
+            .withIndex("by_gallery_and_workspace", (query) =>
+              query
+                .eq("galleryId", gallery._id)
+                .eq("workspaceId", args.workspaceId)
+            )
+            .first(),
+        ])
+
+        if (!client || client.workspaceId !== args.workspaceId) {
+          throw new Error("Gallery client not found")
+        }
+
+        return {
+          ...gallery,
+          clientName: client.name,
+          hasImages: image !== null,
+        }
+      })
+    )
+  },
+})
+
+export const create = mutation({
+  args: {
+    workspaceId: v.id("workspaces"),
+    clientId: v.id("clients"),
+    name: v.string(),
+  },
+  handler: async (ctx, args) => {
+    await requirePaidWorkspace(ctx, args.workspaceId)
+
+    const client = await ctx.db.get(args.clientId)
+
+    if (!client || client.workspaceId !== args.workspaceId) {
+      throw new Error("Client not found")
+    }
+
+    const name = args.name.trim()
+
+    if (!name) {
+      throw new Error("Gallery name is required")
+    }
+
+    return await ctx.db.insert("galleries", {
+      workspaceId: args.workspaceId,
+      clientId: args.clientId,
+      name,
+      status: "draft",
+    })
+  },
+})
+
+export const update = mutation({
+  args: {
+    workspaceId: v.id("workspaces"),
+    galleryId: v.id("galleries"),
+    clientId: v.id("clients"),
+    name: v.string(),
+  },
+  handler: async (ctx, args) => {
+    await requirePaidWorkspace(ctx, args.workspaceId)
+
+    const [gallery, client] = await Promise.all([
+      ctx.db.get(args.galleryId),
+      ctx.db.get(args.clientId),
+    ])
+
+    if (!gallery || gallery.workspaceId !== args.workspaceId) {
+      throw new Error("Gallery not found")
+    }
+
+    if (!client || client.workspaceId !== args.workspaceId) {
+      throw new Error("Client not found")
+    }
+
+    const name = args.name.trim()
+
+    if (!name) {
+      throw new Error("Gallery name is required")
+    }
+
+    await ctx.db.patch(args.galleryId, { clientId: args.clientId, name })
+  },
+})
+
+export const remove = mutation({
+  args: {
+    workspaceId: v.id("workspaces"),
+    galleryId: v.id("galleries"),
+  },
+  handler: async (ctx, args) => {
+    await requirePaidWorkspace(ctx, args.workspaceId)
+
+    const gallery = await ctx.db.get(args.galleryId)
+
+    if (!gallery || gallery.workspaceId !== args.workspaceId) {
+      throw new Error("Gallery not found")
+    }
+
+    const image = await ctx.db
+      .query("galleryImages")
+      .withIndex("by_gallery_and_workspace", (query) =>
+        query
+          .eq("galleryId", args.galleryId)
+          .eq("workspaceId", args.workspaceId)
+      )
+      .first()
+
+    if (image) {
+      throw new Error(
+        "Remove this gallery's images before deleting the gallery"
+      )
+    }
+
+    await ctx.db.delete(args.galleryId)
+  },
+})
+
+export const markReady = mutation({
+  args: {
+    workspaceId: v.id("workspaces"),
+    galleryId: v.id("galleries"),
+  },
+  handler: async (ctx, args) => {
+    await requirePaidWorkspace(ctx, args.workspaceId)
+
+    const gallery = await ctx.db.get(args.galleryId)
+
+    if (!gallery || gallery.workspaceId !== args.workspaceId) {
+      throw new Error("Gallery not found")
+    }
+
+    if (gallery.status !== "draft") {
+      throw new Error("Gallery is already ready")
+    }
+
+    const image = await ctx.db
+      .query("galleryImages")
+      .withIndex("by_gallery_and_workspace", (query) =>
+        query
+          .eq("galleryId", args.galleryId)
+          .eq("workspaceId", args.workspaceId)
+      )
+      .first()
+
+    if (!image) {
+      throw new Error("Add at least one image before marking the gallery ready")
+    }
+
+    await ctx.db.patch(args.galleryId, {
+      status: "ready",
+      readyAt: Date.now(),
+    })
+  },
+})

instructions.text:
# Pickpicker

Picpicker is a SASS app to provide photographers and photography studios a way to receive better feedback of his clients about the pictures he is selling them.

## A note from C4B C level

Ambitious ideas, simple system and software that feels obvious are the core of C4B way of doing software and you should also think like it. Do not preserve complexity jsut because it already exists or introduce machinery because it looks architecturally impressive. Understand the real constraint, then fight for the smallest model that makes the correct behavior unsurprising.

Channel both "measure twice, cut once" and "yagni". Fight scope creep. Try to honor the dev's intent in both a minimal and realistic fashion.

The rest of this document is meant to help you navigate the codebase and make changes effectively. Think of these instructions less as "hard rules", more as "good defaults". The developer's preferences should be able to override anything here.

## Glossary

So we can stay in the same page use this terminology when communicating.

- **you** means the agent reading this file
- **we, us, mainteiners** means joaovitorscr, Mo0inha and any other contributor of this repository. These are who you are talking to now.
- **user** means the photographer, studio manager or other
- **client** means the photographer client that is giving feedback

## Ways to hurt yourself

1. Killing by pattern. Never pkill -f, pgrep | kill, or kill a PID you found by matching a name, path, or worktree string. Your own agent process has this worktree's path in its argv, and this machine runs several other dev servers at once.

## Verifying

- Use the smallest proof that the change works. Do not run every check in both layers unless I ask; CI owns the full suite.
- `pnpm run typecheck` for type checking.

## Working with Linear

For this project we are currently using linear at (https://linear.app/c4b-squad/project/picpicker-d00daf9ba4b9/overview), when making plans for a implementation (refactor, feature) create a new issue and make sub issues for it separating each concern, that way each sub issue will become it's own commit and the issue a full different feature branch. The issue and sub issues will be assigned for the account creating them unless we say otherwise.

## Pull Requests

- Never make a PR unless the developer explicitly asks you to do so.
- Conventional commit titles, plain language: fix(web): new threads no longer spike CPU.
- Body: the problem in a sentence or two, then how you fixed it. End with the model and harness that did the work.
- UI changes need before/after images. Motion or timing needs a short video.
- Upload PR evidence to GitHub. Never commit PR-only screenshots or assets such as .github/pr-assets/.
- One concern per PR. If the description says "also", split it.
- Make sure that the pr's mention the issues on linear giving link backs

## Plans and work artifacts

- Do not commit implementation plans, research notes, or agent scratch files. Keep temporary working material outside the worktree. .plans/ is gitignored only as a safety net for legacy tooling.
- Put durable architecture, constraints, and decisions in docs/internals/. Update those docs when the product changes so agents find current facts instead of abandoned intentions.
- A merged PR is the implementation record. Close or update its tracking item when the work lands; do not preserve a second checklist in the repository.

## Where code lives

- `apps/web` - Next.js app where the users will manage their own workspace, feedback links etc.
- `apps/marketing` - Astro app that will work as a marketing page.
- `apps/collection` - Astro app that will work for the client see their pictures and give feedback for the user.

## Taste

- Complexity belongs at the adapter boundary. Orchestration stays pure, UI stays dumb.
- Inferred types over annotations. any is the enemy.
- Comments describe how a thing is used, and move when the code moves. To be used mostly to describe functions, not to annotate every line of behavior.
- Our users are most of the time developers and people that pay attentions to little details and will notice fps drops, lying spinner, stale labels. No continuously repainting animations; they peg the GPU on high-refresh displays.
- If a rule here fights the task in front of you, say so loudly and get a human sign-off before breaking it.
- All the components used should be from shadcn, from shadcn registry at components.json or a custom built component we approved you to create with base-ui.

## Additional Tips

- Don't verify with browsers or computer use unless the user explicitly agrees or requests it.
- Security is important, but should not be over-indexed on, especially for dev mode/maintainer-only features.

finding.title: Paginate records instead of silently hiding everything after 100
finding.explanation: Both list queries return only the newest 100 records, without a cursor or another way to retrieve older records. The clients view renders that array as the complete list. Creating more records therefore makes existing clients inaccessible for editing or deletion; the same limit hides older galleries.
finding.scenario: In a paid workspace, create 101 clients. The first client disappears from the Clients page and remains inaccessible after reloading. Creating 101 galleries similarly hides the oldest gallery.
finding.suggestedFix: Add pagination to both list queries and expose navigation or load-more controls in their views. Ensure gallery client selection can retrieve older clients too.

records.reason: Head apps/web/convex/clients.ts:24–46 permits repeated creation, while :14–20 returns only the newest 100. Head apps/web/components/clients-view.tsx:100–123 exposes record actions only for that returned array, with no pagination. Thus creating client 101 hides the oldest client's controls. Head apps/web/convex/galleries.ts:14–20 introduces the same truncation for galleries.
